exposure: Keap-1/Nrf2 signaling pathway factors (Keap-1, Nrf2, HO-1, GSK-3b)
Antioxidant enzymes (catalase, glutathione, glutathione peroxidase, superoxide dismutases)
cohort: The study participants were pregnant women from whom placental tissues were collected, categorized into groups with preterm premature rupture of membranes (n=20), full-term premature rupture of membranes (n=20), and normal-term births (n=20).
finding: The study found significantly increased reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels and decreased antioxidant enzymes in patients with PPROM and FPROM compared to the control group, indicating activation of the Keap-1/Nrf2 signaling pathway by oxidative stress in these conditions.
cross-section timing: At the time of birth, when placental and amniotic tissues were collected.
gest_age: Preterm (for PPROM group) and full-term (for FPROM and normal-term birth groups).
